review_basis: Inspected actual native reference/A2/A5 board, three-quarter, profile and blink. No generated/retouched substitute frames.
visible_progress: Face no longer just recolored: nasal base reduced, lower jaw tapered/shortened, lips wider/thinner and corners lifted, iris less cyan, ears less prominent.
Long face-framing hair and center-parted silhouette now replace the source short/ponytail appearance; original Rain character/rig remains underneath.
A4 entirely-black new hair material failure repaired; six A5 native frames now show shaded warm-brown hair.
Upper/lower lid setup improves continuity of the lash edge relative to A2 single-upper closure, but is not a final acting/anatomy pass.
visible_limitations: Hair remains an authored BLOCKOUT/LOOK STUDY: large plank-like clumps, overly regular fiber texture, visible root/crown joins, inadequate natural layered flow. Not cinema-quality grooming.
Hair appears lighter/blonder and less richly brown than canonical mom; lighting differs from reference but this is not treated as an excuse for a color/likeness acceptance.
Face still has recognizable Rain eye sockets/brow/cheek planes; nose/lip/profile identity only partially matches reference.
Reference skin has warmer/rosier variation and softer eye-region presentation; current study is not a final skin lookdev pass.
Lid surface still needs refinement, expression range is unproven beyond limited blink/smile checks.
New clumps rigidly follow original DEF-Head/lattice. No shoulder collision, hair dynamics, full-body motion or speech approval. One original invalid spine driver persists.
next_steps: Integrate part/roots/crown rather than layering obvious clumps; reshape/taper hair into softer asymmetrical waves and bring palette closer.
Refine reference facial planes, eyelids, lip/nasal profile and skin variation in matching multi-view native renders.
Test head motion/hair shoulder clearance, intermediate facial poses and speech before considering wardrobe or production use.
